table_check.consequence: The published 0.40% mean gap refers to Homberger/Gehring 1000-customer VRPTW instances, NOT to the 56 Solomon 100-customer instances in this repository. The local run in this file (Solomon, 15 s/instance, single seed) is therefore NOT comparable to the paper's headline, and the 06 README must not cite 0.40% next to the Solomon ladder.
